text: Teo Osei’s penalty goal at 74' (xG 0.76) resulted directly from Redmond Rovers’ sustained high press and quick ball circulation in their 4-3-3 setup, which forced Ironvale Athletic’s deep defensive line and low block to commit a foul in a dangerous area [#1348] [#1350]. Redmond’s field tilt exceeded 80%, with a PPDA of 6.0, underlining their effective pressing trigger that disrupted Ironvale’s vertical passing buildup and led to a critical set-piece chance. Despite Ironvale’s 5-3-2 defensive overload designed to absorb pressure, their restricted build-up phase increased vulnerability to high turnovers that Redmond exploited to create a high xG opportunity late in the game. The equalizer at 2-2 exemplifies how pressing-induced transitions can force errors against a deep block under pressure.
